page.overview:
Who is Erlich Kerzingblad?

Sir is a knight from a vassal house under House Einfasen.

Despite having had some embarrassing moments in public in the past, his reputation and behavior were good and noble enough for Lord Otto Einfasen to praise him and to consider it normal for him to unexpectedly help a fellow knight on a journey.

Erlich was born in a noble house and became a knight in service of House Einfasen. Eventually he joined the Barrowguard, and was meant to establish it in the north. In the year 63 or 64 after the Shapers' War he attended a ball in Dol-Makjar in which he got drunk and made a fool of himself in front of House Halovar.

As of the year 71, days after the execution of Thjazi Fang, Sir Erlich was supposed to be in Equilaine.
